name: webrtc-neteq
local_changes: The source closure contains the M131 NetEqImpl decision path and its direct production dependencies. TiRTC supplies a private encoded-audio decoder factory and does not import AudioCodingModule, RTP receiver, transport, or the rest of libwebrtc.

TiRTC does not enable NACK, RTX, RED, or transport-owned recovery. Dense private sequence numbers are used only for packet identity; timing decisions consume the source RTP timestamp and the original monotonic receive time carried at the encoded ingress boundary.

PacketArrivedInfo carries an optional original-arrival sample timestamp into PacketArrivalHistory. TiRTC maps encoded-ingress monotonic receive time into NetEQ's TickTimer sample domain so insert-worker delay is not misclassified as network jitter. Remove this adaptation only when upstream NetEQ accepts original receive time in its packet-arrival estimator.

Environment::CreateForNetEq constructs the clock and field-trial subset used by this standalone source closure without importing libwebrtc task-queue or event-log owners. Access to either omitted service remains fail-closed. Remove this factory if the closure later owns those full upstream services.

NetEq::LastOperationForTiRtc exposes the already-selected operation for internal output classification and deterministic validation; it does not override decisions or form a public product contract. Remove it if upstream lifetime statistics provide per-pull operation classification.
reorder_optimizer.cc directly includes <cstdint> so int64_t is declared by its owning header set on MinGW instead of relying on a transitive include.

Shared api, common_audio, rtc_base, and Abseil headers and symbols are reused from the existing webrtc-apm 2.1 source closure at the same WebRTC M131 revision 79aff54b0fa9238ce3518dd9eaf9610cd6f22e82, avoiding duplicate strong symbols.
